decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The
proposal, by reason of failing to provide minimum bedroom widths for the future
residents of a bedroom in the GF Flat, as well as a the FF flat, would result
in a poor standard of living accommodation for future occupiers of those flats,
to the detriment of their residential amenities,&nbsp; contrary to the National Planning Policy
Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3, of the London Plan (2021), Policies DM 1
and DM 26 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013),
The&nbsp; Mayor of London Housing
Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016), the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Housing Design Standards LPG
(2023).<span style="font-size:11.0pt;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal, by reason of the refuse and waste recycling
bins and bicycle stores, in the front garden area, would result in a cluttered
and poor quality environment and would fail to provide adequate secure cycle
parking, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the subject
property and the street scene and the objectives of promoting sustainable
transport, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National
Planning Policy Framework (2023), Core Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core
Strategy, Policies D3.D1, D.11 and T5 of the London Plan (2021), Policies DM 1,
DM 26, DM23, DM42 and DM45 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan
(2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design
Guide (2010).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The
proposal, by reason of incorporating a gantry would harm the character of the surrounding
area, as well as introduce a platform for the overlooking of the adjoining
residential property at no. 40 Milford Gardens, to the detriment of the wider
character and the neighbouring residential amenities,&nbsp; contrary to the National Planning Policy
Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3, of the London Plan (2021), Policies DM 1 of
the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Housing
Design Standards LPG (2023).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal, by reason of the insufficient number of
cycle storage provided within the front amenity space, would result in the
unsatisfactory provision of safe cycle storage facilities, to provide
facilities for all the users of the site and in the interests of highway safety
and sustainable transport, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), &nbsp;Policy T5 of The London Plan (2021) and Policy
DM 42 of the Harrow Development Management Policies (2013).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The applicant </span>h<span lang="EN-US" style="">as failed to submit a Flood Risk Assessment and has therefore failed to
demonstrate that the proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of
flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding
elsewhere, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), policies
SI12 and SI13 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 U of Harrow Core
Strategy (2012) and policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management
Polices Local Plan (2013).</span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Conversion of dwelling to two flats (1 x 2 bed & 1 x 3 bed); installation of first floor level gantry with external steps to rear; external alterations; vehicle access; parking; separate amenity; landscaping; boundary treatment; bin storage
